usages.explain: With the form 「XもXならYもYだ」expresses criticism that both sides have issues.

examples.content: 主も主なら家来も家来だ。
examples.transcription: あるじもあるじならけらいもけらいだ。
examples.mean: If the master is the master, the servants are also servants.

examples.content: 先生も先生なら学生も学生だ。
examples.transcription: せんせいもせんせいならがくせいもがくせいだ。
examples.mean: If a teacher is a teacher, a student is also a student.

title: …も…なら => If N1 is.. then N2.. as well
